items.headline: AI tops agenda at ION's ConnectION event
items.summary: A new ION Commodities poll found commodity firms want control over AI tools rather than black-box automation, even as interest in applying AI to trading workflows remains high, per CTRM Center.

items.headline: Trafigura closes upsized $4.4bn loan package
items.summary: Trafigura finalized an enlarged syndicated loan facility worth US$4.4 billion, underscoring continued bank appetite for financing large physical commodity traders, according to GTR.

items.headline: CMA CGM completes FedEx Supply Chain buyout
items.summary: CMA CGM finalized its $1.4 billion purchase of FedEx Supply Chain, adding roughly 150 warehouses and over 30 million square feet to its CEVA logistics network in North America, per Intelligent Audit.

items.headline: FIA pushes back on ESMA EMIR 7d plan
items.summary: FIA submitted comments to ESMA on the proposed EMIR Article 7d reporting framework, urging a proportionate approach that avoids duplicating existing derivatives reporting obligations for commodity and other market participants.
